raw: {"title":"抛体运动纯物理模型","domain":"projectile","model_js":"globalThis.coursewareModel=Object.freeze({sample(input){const sc=(input&&input.scenario)||{};const ts=(input&&Array.isArray(input.times_s))?input.times_s:[];const num=(v,d)=>{const n=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:d;};const clean=n=>Object.is(n,-0)?0:n;const mode=String(sc.mode||'oblique').toLowerCase();const g=Math.max(1e-12,num(sc.g_m_s2,9.8));const m=num(sc.mass_kg,1);const x0=num(sc.x0_m,0);const y0=num(sc.y0_m,0);const speed=Math.max(0,num(sc.speed_m_s,0));const deg=mode==='horizontal'?0:num(sc.angle_deg,0);const rad=deg*Math.PI/180;const vx0=speed*Math.cos(rad);const vy0=speed*Math.sin(rad);const disc=Math.max(0,vy0*vy0+2*g*y0);const T=(vy0+Math.sqrt(disc))/g;const flight=Number.isFinite(T)&&T>0?T:0;const range=vx0*flight;const tApex=vy0>0?Math.min(vy0/g,flight):0;const maxH=y0+vy0*tApex-0.5*g*tApex*tApex;const states=ts.map(ti=>{const t=Math.max(0,num(ti,0));let x,y,vx,vy,ax,ay;if(t<=flight){x=x0+vx0*t;y=y0+vy0*t-0.5*g*t*t;if(y<0){y=0;}vx=vx0;vy=vy0-g*t;ax=0;ay=-g;}else{x=x0+range;y=0;vx=0;vy=0;ax=0;ay=0;}const ke=0.5*m*(vx*vx+vy*vy);const pe=m*g*y;return{t_s:clean(t),x_m:clean(x),y_m:clean(y),vx_m_s:clean(vx),vy_m_s:clean(vy),ax_m_s2:clean(ax),ay_m_s2:clean(ay),kinetic_j:clean(ke),potential_j:clean(pe),mechanical_j:clean(ke+pe)};});return{states,events:{flight_time_s:clean(flight),range_m:clean(range),apex_time_s:clean(tApex),max_height_m:clean(maxH),optimal_equal_height_angle_deg:45}};}});"}
